symbols.read: Price has slipped to 720.19, still pinned below the 722.40 lower pivot, so the neutral-to-cautious bearish tilt holds and the invalidated SELL setup stays dead but not reversed. Versus the previous read, price has eased off 720.38 and the 1H tick-up has faded to +0.06%, with the 4H still Bearish against a BULLISH regime and the 718.50–718.88 bull FVG still open just beneath. A clean break and hold above 722.40 reopens the path toward 737.02, while rejection here keeps 686.36 in play. Invalidation: a hold above 737.02 confirms a full trend reversal and kills the downside case; a loss of 715.60 (reinforced by the bull FVG beneath it) would revive bearish momentum toward the 686.36 target.

The neutral-hold bias holds and has softened slightly: price has slipped from 81,822.69 to 81,704.55, still pinned above the bullish FVG (81,494.01–81,527.36) but with the last 1H candle closing red, so the 1H up-trend is losing momentum rather than confirming. The short remains invalidated and the mixed structure intact — 4H bearish inside a bullish regime — with 81,033.66 the level that reopens 77,715.32 and 84,352.00 the level that flips structure bullish. The FVG cushion is now the only thing standing between price and a clean test of the lower pivot, so a break below 81,494.01 would put the downside path back in play. Invalidation of the hold: acceptance below 81,033.66 turns the bias bearish; acceptance above 84,352.00 turns it bullish.

Price has slipped from 2,419.38 to 2,410.00, giving back the 2,411.93–2,413.64 reclaim and flipping the 1H trend down (2,411.55→2,408.62), so the prior neutral-to-bullish lean is revised to neutral-to-bearish: the push toward the 2,446–2,455 bear FVG never materialized and momentum has turned against it. The 2,403.69 lower pivot is now the line in the sand, with the small bull FVG at 2,404.31–2,404.84 as the last cushion above it; the SELL setup stays invalidated (entry 2,403.69, stop 2,402.67) and only re-arms on a sustained break below the pivot, which opens 2,227.50. Bias is neutral-to-bearish while price grinds between 2,403.69 and the 2,446 ceiling; a reclaim of 2,446 would neutralize the downside and refocus the upper pivot at 2,579.88.

Bias stays bearish and the short remains invalidated: price at 103.06 sits well below the 107.16 lower pivot, so the 107.16 entry with stop 107.19 and target 100.92 cannot be armed. What changed from the prior read is that the modest recovery has reversed — price fell from 104.02 to 103.06 and the last 1H print turned negative at 103.70→103.31 (-0.38%), keeping the combined read at SELL while the 4H stays bearish and the 1H trend stays down. No open FVGs remain, so the structural picture is unchanged: no buffer beneath price, leaving the path toward 100.92 open rather than cushioned. Invalidation of the bearish lean remains a reclaim of 107.16, and until that prints nothing is live.

Price remains pinned at 56.97 with the 4H bearish structure and combined SELL signal intact, so the read is unchanged: no level breaks, trend flips, or gap fills since the last read. The 58.41 short entry stays expired and untriggered, stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched, and the bearish FVG at 57.42–57.53 still caps as nearest supply while the 1H trend grinds down. Bias stays bearish toward 55.37, with a sustained reclaim of 58.41 the invalidation that would flip the read bullish toward 61.45.

Price is again unchanged at 4,165.42, so this is a straight confirmation of the prior HOLD and neutral-to-long bias — the bullish 4H and up 1H trend remain intact, and nothing has broken. The 1H stall at 4,168.84 and the invalidated SELL at 4,141.44 both still stand, and with no open FVGs price continues to trade on structure alone between 4,217.40 and 4,141.44. The trigger set is unchanged: a sustained break below 4,141.44 flips the bias bearish and re-arms the 4,065.48 target, while a push through 4,217.40 confirms the long side. Conviction stays weak until one of those levels gives, so this remains a confirmation, not a revision.

Bias stays neutral-to-hold: the SELL remains invalidated, 4H is still bearish and 1H still down, with the BULLISH regime flag keeping shorts off the table. What changed is that price has slipped from 1.30 to 1.29, breaking below the 1.296 old bear FVG zone that the prior read flagged as the trigger for the 1.20 path — that level break now puts the downside scenario in play. The 1.31 lower pivot is still the level to reclaim; holding above it keeps 1.43 in play, while staying below 1.296 keeps 1.20 as the active target. Invalidation: a sustained move back above 1.31–1.3283 flips structure bullish and negates the 1.20 path.
